steps.text: Sunlight dances off the snow-capped mountains, rendering them immaculately radiant.
The howling wind carries the tolling of bells and the echoes of chanting voices, weaving through the peaks and narrating countless ancient tales.
Here, time seems to have stopped, as if everything has remained unchanged since the dawn of existence.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Mm—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Judging from the depth of the footprints, the snow here is deeper than expected.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: No doubt from the previous localized snowfall. Given the steep slopes, if the snow keeps accumulating...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I believe the experts that Sir Enciodes hired said there could be heavy snowfall in the next few days.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If that happens...

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: What is it, sir?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Take a team and measure the depth of the snow, then get an expert to look at the slope gradient...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And assess the risk of avalanche.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Then... I'll report to Sir Enciodes once this message has been passed on.
Weiss cannot help but frown at the scene before him.
Soldiers wearing the finest armor and wielding the best weapons have lost all will to fight.
Most lie moaning on the ground. Only a few still have the strength to glare at the tall, blonde woman who put them in this miserable state.
Weiss raises an eyebrow slightly at the sight of the old man beside the woman.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I presume you are not willing to grace us with your presence?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm just here to whip these weaklings into shape.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: There is no need for banquets.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I simply wish to express my appreciation for your training of Clan Silverash's warriors.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm not training them for Clan Silverash.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And they won't be serving you.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes has a message for you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He has a meeting, and your presence is required.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Where is he?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Waiting for you at home.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That's enough for today. Dismissed.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I've heard that she was a stubborn one. Today I got to see for myself.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You should not have come, Mr. Edwin.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Have to hear it with my own ears to give up.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Just as well. I wanted to talk to you too, Weiss. A moment?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: ...Certainly.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: What is it, Mr. Edwin?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I'll cut straight to the chase. What do you think about Degenbrecher, Weiss?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: She's very strong. Sir Enciodes is much safer with her around.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You're a smart kid, Weiss. You know that isn't what I'm asking.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You want to know what I think of her presence.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: She has taken your place ever since Sir Enciodes brought her back. Do you truly not think anything of it?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: What I think is not important. What's important is that Sir Enciodes's work is progressing.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You sound like you don't like her.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I've heard her reputation, a three-time champion somewhere. And it's every bit well deserved, from what I saw today.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: But to spend so much money on one person, and putting her in such an important position...

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: If I may be blunt... Enciodes was shortsighted with this decision.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Pray be careful about your words, Mr. Edwin.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Ever his steadfast defender.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I watched him grow up. He has to call me mister, same as you.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Do you think the others don't think the same way? They're just too afraid to speak their mind.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'm sure it has occurred to you that Sir Enciodes did this in order to gain a foothold in Victorian high society.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Then why not leave her in Victoria?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Did he forget he already has a bodyguard in Kjerag?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: And what would this bodyguard think when he saw her?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: As I've said, what I think is not important.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Perhaps that's your outlook. You're a humble boy, after all.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: But what of the others?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: How much ground did the Paleroches and Browntails take from us in the years that he was abroad?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: How many went over to their sides?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Who fought tooth and nail to earn what Silverash has now?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Master Chester, Matterhorn, you, and old-timers like us.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Even if you don't think that way, how many would be envious? Unhappy?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: This isn't about Degenbrecher. I've seen my share of proud and capable youngsters.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: One or two of her won't do any harm.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: But those young people he brought back from Victoria will strip our flesh from our bones.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes doesn't play favorites.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Of course, he hasn't neglected us.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: But is that enough? Why are those fledglings considered our equals and even given better treatment?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Why should we step aside for them, after all that we've given for the clan?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Perhaps Sir Enciodes sees their value.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What value? Like my second son, who believes the future of Kjerag is in his hands just because he learned a few tricks?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Does Sir Enciodes really believe these arrogant fools can contribute to Kjerag's future?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Why are you so certain that I'm on your side, Mr. Edwin?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I watched you and Matterhorn give everything for the clan in the years that Sir Enciodes was away.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Never mind my old friends. I would say this for you two kids.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What does it matter if you go and tell him?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I would say the same to his face, if he was standing in front of me today.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: But young people never listen.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You want to make an example of Madam Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Sir Enciodes, and the young people around him, need to realize that no foreigner can be the master of Kjerag.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: The easiest way to deal with a flock of unruly fowlbeasts is to make an example of the one that flies the highest.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: We finished the survey, sir.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: What did the expert say?

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Sir, I...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes trusts him. You can speak frankly.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Yes, sir. The expert says that your assessment is correct, and that the slopes over there are dangerous.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Any further snowfall could potentially cause an avalanche.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: ...I wish I was wrong.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: We were fortunate to find out now. It would have been too late, if not for your experience.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: We should report it to Sir Enciodes, shouldn't we?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: ...I'll do it. Continue to keep an eye on things.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What's on your mind, Weiss?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I understand where you're coming from, Mr. Edwin.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Your concern for the future of Clan Silverash is most touching.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I knew you would understand.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I have an idea.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You heard the report. An avalanche is likely to occur in the near future.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I will ask Sir Enciodes to have Madam Degenbrecher organize a training near where the avalanche is expected to occur.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: When it does, we will request assistance.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Who knows what will happen in the chaos?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: ...A fine plan.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I would have thought it premeditated, had I not heard you talking to your men.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Wait, no, I understand. You've been thinking about this for a while, haven't you?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Yes. The others don't know you, but I do. You're a proud boy, deep down.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You won't just let someone take your place.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes, I've been waiting for someone loyal to Silverash like yourself.
The old man did not notice the emphasis that Weiss placed on 'Silverash'.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir, as I was delivering the message, I discovered that an avalanche is likely to occur around Moonfang Peak.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How sure are you?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Based on my recent meteorological and geographical studies, 90% sure.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Expert analysis has confirmed the observation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is an opportunity.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do as you see fit.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I said you didn't need to call me 'sir'.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Old habits die hard.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I may need to borrow Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Not a problem.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You'll have to convince her yourself, though.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Ha. I'll try.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Oh, I ran into Mr. Edwin today.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Oh? I've heard he's been active. What did he say?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He seems to be in good spirits, and sends you his regards.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What is it, Weiss? Coming out here was quite the trip for my old bones.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There is something I wish to discuss.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What is it? Have you made arrangements regarding Degenbrecher?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Of course. No need to worry.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Say, why are there so few people in the village?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Simple.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: My men went door to door to persuade the villagers to evacuate.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The stubborn conservatives are the only ones left.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Conservatives? Evacuate?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It would have taken more effort if you were better-informed.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Makes my preparations seem pointless when you just show up like this.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You... you set me up?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Not quite.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Didn't you hear there was going to be an avalanche?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: This is the place it's expected to happen.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What did you just say?!

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Are you out of your mind, Weiss?!

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I expected you to tell Enciodes, but I didn't expect this!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'm not sure what you mean.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You lured me here and won't let me leave... what do you think I mean?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You thought I brought you to 'Kjeragandr's turnover' to eliminate you?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What else?! You cold-hearted, ungrateful bastard!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes, that's what the people of Kjerag would have thought in the past.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'll be frank with you, Mr. Edwin.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There are easier ways to kill you, if that's what I intended.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Progress report.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: All the buildings near the mountain have been demolished. We have plenty of space to set up a line of defense.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: As expected, however, we are meeting resistance from some of the residents who refuse to leave.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The evacuation?

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Most of the residents are listening to us and are evacuating. The more stubborn ones refuse to believe us, though.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Leave it to me.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Where are you going, sir?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Requesting Madam Degenbrecher's assistance.
The old noble frantically tries to escape the room, no longer paying attention to what Weiss is saying.
However, Weiss seizes him by the shoulders and pushes his bloated frame toward the warrior.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Take good care of Mr. Edwin while I'm gone.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Don't worry, Mr. Edwin. You'll live, at least for today.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I need your help with something, Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're out of breath. Something serious?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We believe an avalanche is about to occur near Moonfang Peak, and we need your help.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Do you really need my help?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Of course—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: My team has set up defenses, but I need you and your team to help protect the residents who insist on staying.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If I recall correctly, Enciodes has given you and your team quite the power.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You seem too smart to leave such a large gap that would need me to cover.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We're short-handed, after all.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm curious. Why go to such lengths for me?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: When I was little, I would sometimes run off into the mountains after a fight with Matterhorn.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But I always went back home for dinner, my tail between my legs, when I got hungry,

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: That was when I learned—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: No matter what we do out there during the day, we always return to the same place and eat at the same table at night.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And it would be too awkward to be on bad terms with someone else at that table.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You heard the man.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Get ready to move.

steps.name: Warriors
steps.text: Ma'am, yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Like master, like servant. You're just like Enciodes.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You just reminded me, though.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Speaking of avalanche...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Say—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Isn't 'madam' a little too distant when we're eating at the same table?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Change it.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Well.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'll leave it to you...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Degenbrecher.
Degenbrecher does not turn around, but neither does she complain.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Time to deal with the other problem.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: What did Madam Degenbrecher say?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: She will help.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Good to hear. The people's opinion of her will change, if they see her help them out.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It's not that she wouldn't. She just needed a chance.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: What of Mr. Edwin?

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Much calmer. He asked for a cup of tea.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: That's the Mr. Edwin I know.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I told you, I would say the same to Sir Enciodes's face.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I was a fool to be deceived by your facade and to believe you could be won over. You've got me—now do as you will.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I went through all this trouble because I know what kind of person you are.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If you'd been anything else, you would have died that day in the mountains.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Hmph. Now I'm curious why you planned all this.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You were setting the stage for Degenbrecher from the beginning?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: She'll get there eventually, I'm just helping speed things up.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Why go to such lengths for her?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You thought I would dislike Degenbrecher, because you thought I was like you.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: A decade ago, perhaps I'd agree. But I let those feelings go a long time ago.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There are many ways that I can serve Sir Enciodes. Being his bodyguard is not the only way.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And I'm sure he would be disappointed in me if I agreed with you.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Not loathing Degenbrecher is one thing. Why would you help her? Would she even appreciate it?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: At first, I only trusted the judgment of Sir Enciodes, who brought her here. And I admit, she was not easy to get along with.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But when you understand that her aloofness is not hostility, only detachment, even confusion...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Then you realize there is no reason to fear her.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You've never seen her standing in the woods, patiently listening to a herder's small talk despite her apparent indifference.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If you had, you would want more people to understand and accept her, as I do.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It will be a good thing for Kjerag, for herself, and for Sir Enciodes, if she is accepted by Kjerag.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: As for whether she appreciates my help... that doesn't matter.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Does Enciodes know what you're doing?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes has to take radical measures to achieve his vision.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Opposition to his methods is expected, but he only has so much time and energy, and he cannot deal with all of it on his own.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'm simply helping to share the burden where I can.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Whether he knows it or not is equally unimportant.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Follow me, Mr. Edwin.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You will soon learn that Sir Enciodes's vision has long been much more than just the Silverash Clan.
The old noble suddenly thinks that the avalanche does not matter anymore.
Because he sees a vast open expanse where houses once stood.
A dozen or so massive trucks, laden with heavy machinery, are parked across the field. The robotic arms of the machinery transform and interlock—
Coming together to form a wall of steel.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: What is—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: There is a bit of a story behind this.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I've become quite familiar with the mountains and snow of Kjerag, after years of delivering Sir Enciodes's letters.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: When he returned to Kjerag, he authorized me to form an avalanche warning team.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We were able to accurately predict this avalanche with the help of the experts who came back to Kjerag with him.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We can't stop a big avalanche, but we can trigger it before it builds up beyond our capabilities.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: That way, we nip large-scale avalanches in the bud, and prevent them from happening.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: You're too humble, sir.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Initially, we thought the best we could do was issue avalanche warnings ahead of time; since we didn't have the people or resources to stop them.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Your plan completely changed things.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I just came up with the idea. It's the experts who cracked the complicated math.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Preventing large avalanches?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Yes. You're looking at our line of defense.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It will grow even stronger in the future.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: When that day comes, anyone can stand where you stand right now, and watch Kjeragandr's turnover.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But for now, you're the first to be in that best seat.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Watch as it begins.
It begins with a small chunk of snow slipping and falling. As though it were a cue, a low, deep rumble reverberates through the valley.
In an instant, the trickle of snow transforms into a roaring torrent, uprooting trees and sweeping away boulders.
The avalanche hurtles down the mountainside with terrifying speed, as if the entire mountain is spilling forth. Everywhere it passes, it paints an awe-inspiring yet dreadfully horrifying picture.
It was once the stuff of nightmares for the people of Kjerag, one that they could not flee fast enough from.
This time, however, a group of brave men and women stands firm at the mountain's foot, looking up with confidence.
With the wall of steel that they have built, they vow to challenge this snowy authority that has gone uncontested since time immemorial.
The tidal wave of ice and snow crashes against the line of defense formed by the trucks.
Despite being thousands of times heavier than man, the massive trucks seem insignificant before the power of nature and are pushed back. Some are even toppled.
But the wisdom of man prevails.
Gradually, the force pushing against the line of steel diminishes.
The defense line buckles, but it does not break, slowly coming to a stop a dozen meters before Weiss and the old man.
The avalanche, triggered by human hands, has been stopped.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: When the new railroad is finished, it will carry this line of defense to every corner of Kjerag, ready to respond at a moment's notice.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Long has Kjeragandr's turnover been the terror of Kjerag. Many are the lives and homes it has taken.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But in the near future, the people of Kjerag will sit where you are now, watching our defense line stop avalanches, just as it did today.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Could you ever imagine something like this?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: No, you couldn't.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Neither could I.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But it's happening before our eyes.
The old man's scarf has flown away in the wind, his hair and beard are caked with snow. Otherwise, he is completely unharmed.
Weiss continues to grab his shoulder with an iron hand, not giving him the slightest chance to escape.
But if he paid attention, the old noble would notice with a side glance that Weiss's attention is not on him at all.
His eyes are fixed on the line of steel that he has organized. His tightened grip on the old noble's shoulders is simply out of sheer excitement.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Degenbrecher?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Shouldn't you be assisting with the evacuation?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Why are you coming down from the avalanche—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Wait, what's that on your back—?!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I heard there was a couple who weren't able to get out in time. I went to look for them.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: They're alive.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Get them to a doctor, now.

steps.name: Agile Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Yes, sir. And ma'am!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I... Thank you so much, Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So that's an avalanche. Interesting.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'll be going. Feel free to call me when there's another one.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Will do.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: She charged into that avalanche on her own?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Honestly, I didn't expect it either.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: But I hope you understand now.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The foreigners are given better treatment because they have what Kjerag doesn't, what Kjerag can't even imagine.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Think about it, Mr. Edwin.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Would you, or those behind you rather get swept away by the tide?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Or would you rather ride it and watch as we conquer what once seemed insurmountable?

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Is it too late to get on board?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It's never too late.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes welcomes everyone who is willing to build a new Kjerag together.
A moment of silence, then the old man nods, if only reluctantly.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I suppose I've grown old.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Not that old. Kjerag still needs you.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: ...I'll think about it. And I'll talk to them.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We're counting on it.
Weiss smiles.
The old man has seen Weiss smile many times. He knows that, more often than not, it is simply a form of self-defense.
But this time, it is sincere.
Sunlight dances on his face, and his smile is radiant.
